minutes.headline: Select Board approved the Uma Flowers host agreement and leaned against a special election for the vacant seat.
minutes.summary: The board reviewed fallout from the special town meeting and agreed to rework the TC Pacios committee's charge around actual space needs, aiming to bring articles to annual town meeting. It voted to add two members to the stormwater task force, approved the Uma Flowers host community agreement, granted a utility pole petition, and released the right of first refusal on a parcel. Members were not inclined to hold a special election for the vacant seat.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to approve the Uma Flowers host community agreement.
The board took no action on a special election for the vacant seat and will later highlight the charter's petition process.
The board agreed to rework the TC Pacios committee's charge, with a revised charge on the December 14 agenda and articles aimed at annual town meeting.
The board voted to add two at-large members to the stormwater task force, making five members.
Votes on a utility pole petition and on releasing the town's right of first refusal on a parcel were not audible in the captions.

why_it_matters: With no special election planned, the vacant seat stays empty unless residents use the charter petition process, which a resident asked the board to explain.

The TC Pacios charge and the affordability question raised in public comment shape whether building articles reach annual town meeting, which residents would be asked to vote on and which would affect debt and taxes.
